proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C h
  have sA : 0 < Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) :=
    EuclideanGeometry.sin_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [Set.insert_comm])
  have sB : 0 < Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) := EuclideanGeometry.sin_pos_of_not_collinear h
  have sC : 0 < Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A) :=
    EuclideanGeometry.sin_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [show ({B, C, A} : Set P) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto])
  have l1 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist A B C
  have l2 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist B C A
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C A B] at l1
  constructor
  · rw [div_eq_div_iff sA.ne' sB.ne']; linarith
  · rw [div_eq_div_iff sB.ne' sC.ne']; linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → dist B C / Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C) = dist C A / Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) ∧ dist C A / Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) = dist A B / Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A)
